CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #11
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft- Pottery.

3. Best practice when working on Rhythm and Pattern Making: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm and Pattern Making with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm and Pattern Making.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm and Pattern Making.

4. Best practice when working on Painting and Collage: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Collage.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting and Collage.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Collage.
   D. Practise Painting and Collage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Volleyball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Volleyball.
   B. Practise Volleyball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Volleyball.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Volleyball.

6. Best practice when working on Weaving: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Weaving.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Weaving.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Weaving.
   D. Practise Weaving with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   C. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

9. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   B. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.
   D. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Instrumental Ensembles.

10. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.

11. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   B. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

12. Best practice when working on String Musical Instruments and Drawing: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   B. Disrupt classmates during String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   C. Damage equipment used for String Musical Instruments and Drawing.
   D. Practise String Musical Instruments and Drawing with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and Pattern Making and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Weaving and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Gymnastics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
